title: The Name of the Sovereign
summary: In the hidden 1920s laboratory, Kuro reveals the true name of the First Sovereign: Lord Asmodaius. Humiliated by the Sovereign's spiritual pressure, Hunter Jun-Hyuk injects corrupted demonic serum into his own veins, transforming into a savage hybrid monster.

panels.action: Agent Jun-Hyuk drops down into the dust of the amphitheater floor, twirling his twin silver blades with practiced arrogance.
panels.prose_en: Agent Jun-Hyuk drops down into the dust of the amphitheater floor, twirling his twin silver blades with practiced arrogance.
panels.prose_hi: Agent jun-hyuk abhyas ahankaar ke saath apne judwan chandi ke blade ko ghumate hue, emphitheater ke farsh ki dhul mein gir jata hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk wipes blood from his scratched cheek with a white glove: 'Ek chuha basement mein chupa baitha hai. Kitna aam hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Ek chuha basement mein chupa baitha hai.

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk wipes blood from his scratched cheek with a white glove: 'Ek chuha basement mein chupa baitha hai. Kitna aam hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ek safed dastaane se apne kharonche hue gaal se khoon ponchte han: 'ek chuha basement mein chhupa baitha hai. 'kitna aam hai.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands motionless in the center of the dissecting pit; his crystalline gauntlet emits deep, pulsing purrs of violet mana.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands motionless in the center of the dissecting pit; his crystalline gauntlet emits deep, pulsing purrs of violet mana.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun vichchhedan gaddhe ke kendra mein gatiheen khada hai; uska crystaliy gauntlet baingani man ki gahri, spandit gadgdahat ka utsarjan karta hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk glances at the glowing demon specimen jars on the walls: 'Toh tumne yeh lab dhoond li. Ab tum jaante ho yeh academy kya thi.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Ab tum jaante ho yeh academy aakhir kya thi.

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk glances at the glowing demon specimen jars on the walls: 'Toh tumne yeh lab dhoond li. Ab tum jaante ho yeh academy kya thi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk diwaron par chamakte danav namune ke jar ko dekhta hai: 'to tumne yeh lab dhoondh li. ab tum jaante ho yeh academy kya thi.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Main jaanta hoon tum log koi hero nahi ho. Tum sirf immortal army banane ke liye Relics chura rahe ho.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum log hero nahi... chor ho jo Relics chura rahe ho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'Main jaanta hoon tum log koi hero nahi ho. Tum sirf immortal army banane ke liye Relics chura rahe ho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun: 'main jaanta hun tum log koi hero nahin ho. tum sirf amar sena banane ke liye avashesh chura rahe ho.'

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk laughs with cold cynicism: 'Taqat unki hoti hai jo usse cheen sakein. Insaan kamzor the—Relics unka ilaaj hain.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Taqat unki hoti hai jo cheen sakein!

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk laughs with cold cynicism: 'Taqat unki hoti hai jo usse cheen sakein. Insaan kamzor the—Relics unka ilaaj hain.'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk thandi nirasha ke saath hanste han: 'taakat unki hoti hai jo use chheen saken. insaan kamzor the—avshesh unka ilaaj han.'

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk hurls three silver throwing daggers coated in burning holy fire straight toward Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk hurls three silver throwing daggers coated in burning holy fire straight toward Ha-Jun's chest.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ne jalti hui pavitra agni mein lipte teen chandi ke khanjar sidhe ha-jun ki chhati ki or fenke.

panels.action: Ha-Jun raises his left hand; fluid blood from the Ring of Hollow Blood manifests an umbrella-shaped crimson shield, deflecting all three daggers in sparks.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises his left hand; fluid blood from the Ring of Hollow Blood manifests an umbrella-shaped crimson shield, deflecting all three daggers in sparks.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apna bayan haath uthata hai; ring off hollow blood se taral rakt ek chhatri ke aakaar ki lal dhal ko prakat karta hai, jo teenon khanjaron ko chingari mein vikshepit karta hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk gasps in shock: 'Solidified blood shield?! Woh... Ring of Hollow Blood hai?! Tumne doosra relic bhi baandh liya?!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Ring of Hollow Blood... tumne baandh liya?!

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk gasps in shock: 'Solidified blood shield?! Woh... Ring of Hollow Blood hai?! Tumne doosra relic bhi baandh liya?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk sadme mein hanfta hai: 'thos rakt dhal?! vo... ring off hollow blood hai?! tumne dusra avashesh bhi bandh liya?!'.

panels.action: Kuro circles above the amphitheater, his telepathic voice booming like thunder: 'WO SIRF RELIC DHOONDTA NAHI—RELICS USKI GULAMI KARTE HAIN!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Wo waris hai! Relics uske aadesh par chalte hain!

panels.prose_en: Kuro circles above the amphitheater, his telepathic voice booming like thunder: 'WO SIRF RELIC DHOONDTA NAHI—RELICS USKI GULAMI KARTE HAIN!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro emphitheater ke upar chakkar lagata hai, uski telepathic awaz gadgdahat ki tarah tej hoti hai: 'vo sirf avashesh dhundhta nahin- avashesh uski gulami karte han!'

panels.action: The faded chalk pentagrams on the giant blackboard ignite in blinding violet fire, illuminating the amphitheater in spectral violet light.
panels.prose_en: The faded chalk pentagrams on the giant blackboard ignite in blinding violet fire, illuminating the amphitheater in spectral violet light.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal blackboard par fike chalk pentagram chakachaundh kar dene wali baingani aag mein prajvalit hote han, jisse emphitheater varnakramiy baingani prakash mein jagmaga uthta hai.

panels.action: Kuro flares his wings, projecting the ancestral memories of the First Sovereign into the burning chalk runes.
panels.prose_en: Kuro flares his wings, projecting the ancestral memories of the First Sovereign into the burning chalk runes.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne pankh fadfadaye aur pratham samprabhu ki patrik smritiyon ko jalti hui chak daud mein prakshepit kiya.

panels.action: A colossal 30-foot phantom silhouette of the First Sovereign appears floating behind Ha-Jun, holding a titanic curved void scythe.

dialogue.text: Prachin kaal ka sabse bhayankar shaitan.

panels.prose_en: A colossal 30-foot phantom silhouette of the First Sovereign appears floating behind Ha-Jun, holding a titanic curved void scythe.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke peeche first sovereign ka ek vishal 30 foot ka pret chhayachitra tairta hua dikhai deta hai, jo ek titanic ghumavdar shunya daranti ko pakde hue hai.

panels.shot: true name burning runes in air macro
panels.action: Ancient demonic letters burn in mid-air: [RULER OF THE ABYSS: LORD ASMODAIUS].
panels.prose_en: Ancient demonic letters burn in mid-air: [RULER OF THE ABYSS: LORD ASMODAIUS].
panels.prose_hi: Prachin rakshasi patra madhya hawa mein jalte han: [rasatal ka shasak: bhagwan asamodius].

panels.action: Kuro: 'Insaano aur devtaon se pehle... Lord Asmodaius ne nau narko par apna adhipatya jamaya tha!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Lord Asmodaius ka khoon is ladke mein behta hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro: 'Insaano aur devtaon se pehle... Lord Asmodaius ne nau narko par apna adhipatya jamaya tha!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro: 'insanon aur devtaon se pahle... bhagwan asamodius ne nau narko par apna adhipatya jamaya tha!'.

panels.shot: hunter falling to knees under pressure
panels.action: The immense spiritual pressure of the True Name crushes Jun-Hyuk down onto one knee; floorboards crack beneath his boots.
panels.prose_en: The immense spiritual pressure of the True Name crushes Jun-Hyuk down onto one knee; floorboards crack beneath his boots.
panels.prose_hi: Sacche naam ka atyadhik aadhyatmik dabav jun-hyuk ko ek ghutne par kuchal deta hai; uske jooton ke neeche florbord toot jaate han.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk sweats profusely, his twin silver blades vibrating so violently from demonic frequency that his wrists ache.

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Y-Yeh kaisa wazan hai...?! Saans ruk rahi hai...!

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk sweats profusely, his twin silver blades vibrating so violently from demonic frequency that his wrists ache.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ko atyadhik pasina aata hai, uske judwan chandi ke blade rakshasi aavritti se itni tivrata se kampan karte hain ki uski kalaiyon mein dard hone lagta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun walks toward him with slow, regal steps; each footstep leaves a glowing violet footprint burning into the parquet wood.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun walks toward him with slow, regal steps; each footstep leaves a glowing violet footprint burning into the parquet wood.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dhime, shahi kadmon se uski or badhta hai; pratyek padchaap lakdi ki lakdi mein jalte hue ek chamakdar baingani padachihn chhodta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun speaks with two harmonizing voices: 'Tumne mujhe parasite kaha. Lekin mere baap-dada ke ghar mein ghusne wale chor tum ho.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Mere purvajon ke ghar mein ghusne wale chor tum ho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun speaks with two harmonizing voices: 'Tumne mujhe parasite kaha. Lekin mere baap-dada ke ghar mein ghusne wale chor tum ho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun do surili aawajon mein bolta hai: 'tumne mujhe parjivi kaha. lekin mere bap-dada ke ghar mein ghusne wale chor tum ho.'

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk's face twists in venomous humiliated fury: 'Main Class-B Hunter hoon! Main kisi shaitan ke aage nahi jhukunga!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Main kisi shaitan ke aage nahi jhukunga!!

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk's face twists in venomous humiliated fury: 'Main Class-B Hunter hoon! Main kisi shaitan ke aage nahi jhukunga!'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ka chehra zahreele apmanit gusse mein ghum gaya: 'main clas-bi hunter hun! main kisi shaitan ke aage nahin jhukunga!'.

panels.shot: crushing violet ampoule into neck macro
panels.action: Jun-Hyuk pulls a glass ampoule of bubbling violet demonic serum from his chest pocket and violently slams it into his carotid artery.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk pulls a glass ampoule of bubbling violet demonic serum from his chest pocket and violently slams it into his carotid artery.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk apni chhati ki jeb se bulbuledar baingani rakshasi serum ka ek glass ample khinchta hai aur use hinsak roop se apni caroted dhamni mein patak deta hai.

panels.action: Thick, corrupt black-and-violet demonic veins bulge rapidly across Jun-Hyuk's neck and face; his muscles swell violently.
panels.prose_en: Thick, corrupt black-and-violet demonic veins bulge rapidly across Jun-Hyuk's neck and face; his muscles swell violently.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ki gardan aur chehre par moti, bhrasht kali aur baingani rakshasi nasen teji se ubhari hui han; uski manspeshiyan teji se suj jaati han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's brow furrows in sheer disgust: 'Demon Hunter hokar... apne hi shareer mein demonic blood inject kar liya?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hunter hokar demon blood inject kar liya?! Kitni gandagi hai!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's brow furrows in sheer disgust: 'Demon Hunter hokar... apne hi shareer mein demonic blood inject kar liya?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki bhaunhen behad ghrina se sikudti han: 'deman hunter hokar... apne hi shareer mein rakshasi khoon inject kar liya?!'

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk's eyes turn blood-red with black sclera; he grins like a rabid beast: 'Bureau ka secret weapon: Hybrid Transfusion!'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Hybrid Transfusion! Ab dekhte hain kiska khoon bada hai!

panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk's eyes turn blood-red with black sclera; he grins like a rabid beast: 'Bureau ka secret weapon: Hybrid Transfusion!'.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ki aankhen kale shwetpatal se rakt-lal ho jaati han; wah ek pagal janwar ki tarah muskurata hai: 'buro ka gupt hathiyar: hybrid transfusion!'.

panels.action: Two jagged demonic bone spikes burst outward from Jun-Hyuk's elbows, and black hellfire coats his vibrating silver swords.
panels.prose_en: Two jagged demonic bone spikes burst outward from Jun-Hyuk's elbows, and black hellfire coats his vibrating silver swords.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ki kohniyon se do dantedar rakshasi haddi ke kante bahar ki or futate han, aur kali narkankaal uski hilti hui chandi ki talwaron ko dhak deti hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk explodes forward at supersonic speed, obliterating five tiers of antique wooden amphitheater benches into flying splinters.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk explodes forward at supersonic speed, obliterating five tiers of antique wooden amphitheater benches into flying splinters.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk supersonic gati se aage badhta hai, prachin lakdi ke emphitheater bench ke paanch staron ko udte hue tukdon mein nasht kar deta hai.

panels.action: Jun-Hyuk's corrupted blade slams into Ha-Jun's blood shield; spiderweb fractures split the crimson barrier under monstrous force.
panels.prose_en: Jun-Hyuk's corrupted blade slams into Ha-Jun's blood shield; spiderweb fractures split the crimson barrier under monstrous force.
panels.prose_hi: Jun-hyuk ka bhrasht blade ha-jun ki rakt dhal se takrata hai; spiderweb fracture ne rakshasi bal ke tahat crimson barrier ko vibhajit kar diya.

panels.action: Kuro shrieks: 'Isne apni insaaniyat bech di hai! Iski taqat ab ek wild beast jaisi hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Sambhlo! Yeh pagal ho chuka hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro shrieks: 'Isne apni insaaniyat bech di hai! Iski taqat ab ek wild beast jaisi hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chillata hai: 'isne apni insaniyat bech di hai! iski taaqat ab ek junglee janwar jaisa hai!'.

panels.action: The corrupted silver blade bypasses the cracked shield, slicing through Ha-Jun's navy blazer and grazing his shoulder; scarlet blood sprays.
panels.prose_en: The corrupted silver blade bypasses the cracked shield, slicing through Ha-Jun's navy blazer and grazing his shoulder; scarlet blood sprays.
panels.prose_hi: Dushit chandi ka blade tuti hui dhal ko paar kar jata hai, ha-jun ke navy blazer ko kaatata hai aur uske kandhe ko chhuta hai; scarlet rakt spre.

panels.shot: black sclera crimson sovereign eyes cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun's blood droplet hits the floor; his irises turn completely black with twin glowing crimson-violet monarch rings: 'Tumhe monster dekhna tha? Ab Asmodaius ka astitva dekho.'
panels.mood: true sovereign rage unleashed, ultimate cliffhanger

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumhe monster dekhna tha na? Ab dekho.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's blood droplet hits the floor; his irises turn completely black with twin glowing crimson-violet monarch rings: 'Tumhe monster dekhna tha? Ab Asmodaius ka astitva dekho.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ki khoon ki boond farsh se takrati hai; uski aankhon ki putli judwan chamakdar lal-bangni monark chhallon ke saath puri tarah se kali ho jaati hai: 'tumhen rakshas dekhna tha? ab asamodius ka astitva dekho.'
